name: Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
summary: Odlewnia Kalwisz is a privately owned Polish foundry (210 staff, 9.8 M EUR turnover). It started a restructuring programme with its banks after two loss-making years, and its managing director is pushing for faster payment. Its delivery and quality performance with us is red: OTD 63.5 % against a 95 % target and 2376 ppm, and Supplier Quality formally escalated on 2026-09-21 for the bearing bracket, which is 100 % sourced here.

situation.decision_maker: managing director (owner-run private firm); bank oversight constrains any margin-reducing deal

negotiation_pattern: Annual renewals only. It usually opens mildly and settles lower: mean asked -0.18 %, settled -2.37 %. In Nov 2024 it asked +1.3 % and +3.8 % and both settled at 0 %. In Dec 2025 it asked -1.0 % and settled -2.5 % on 310020, and asked +2.8 % and settled 0 % on 310030. It has historically given in to pressure. That has now changed: in July 2026 the MD said he 'cannot sign anything that lowers our margin now', and its latest quote on 310020 holds the price at 45.15 but asks for 10-day payment.
wants: faster payment (10 days requested), and simply being paid on time
stable price, with no margin erosion while under bank watch
volume and contract security to show its banks
avoiding loss of share and chargeback escalation after the red scorecard
protects: unit_price (no reductions; MD cannot sign margin cuts under bank watch; 310030 already sits below the no-margin should-cost estimate)
payment_days at 60 is the thing it wants to change, so it will not offer anything that lengthens it

trades.get: a cash discount (skonto) plus a binding OTD/ppm improvement plan for part:310020
trades.why: Liquidity is its top need; it already offered a discount for 10-day payment.

trades.give: unit_price held flat for 2027 (no reduction demand on 310020/310030)
trades.get: ppm_commitment (e.g. <1000 ppm) and a higher chargeback_eur_per_complaint than the current EUR 150
trades.why: Price is its red line; cost recovery on quality hurts it less than a margin cut and addresses our real problem.

trades.give: contract_months extension beyond 2027-06-30 / volume_per_year security, conditional on quarterly OTD and ppm milestones
trades.get: OTD recovery toward the 95 % target, a lead_time_days commitment of 56, and a firm price for the term
trades.why: Contract and volume visibility helps its bank story; the milestones protect us if it fails.

arguments.point: We pay 93 % of invoices late, on average 8.8 days after due. Paying fast and on time is real liquidity we can offer in exchange for performance.
The scorecard is red and worsening. OTD fell from 78.0 % to 63.5 % against a 95 % contractual target, and ppm has stayed at 2376-3079 for a year. Its share is at stake.
We have alternatives. Part 310030 has 2 other sources and Kalwisz holds only 30 % quota. Part 310020 has 1 other source.
Its quote for part:310010 rose from 124.20 (Jan 2025) to 143.22 (Sep 2026). That is above the no-margin estimate of 132.64 (low confidence) and gives no basis for new volume at that price.

avoid: demanding unit_price cuts: the MD has said he cannot sign them, and 310030 is already -16.2 % vs the no-margin estimate
open exit threats or a sudden quota cut on 310020; this could tip a restructuring firm and endanger supply of a 100 %-quota part
prepayment or unsecured advances to a company in bank restructuring
awarding new volume (310010) or a long extension without quality milestones
agreeing to 10-day payment without a stated skonto rate and quality commitments in return
tone: Firm and factual on quality, with numbers; constructive and partnership-minded on cash. Show a path where performance earns faster payment and security.
red_flags: Insolvency risk: restructuring with banks after two loss-making years; 'bank is watching every month'
Supply risk on part:310020: 100 % quota, supplier-owned tooling, only 1 alternative; secure a tooling/second-source plan
Quality: 2376 ppm, 13 complaints and 3 open 8D in the last 12 months
Contract price-change notice deadline (90 days before year end) falls around 2026-10-02; expect pressure before then

evidence.claim: Restructuring programme with banks after two loss-making years
MD asked twice for earlier payment; will not sign anything that lowers margin
Requested 10-day payment in exchange for a cash discount; latest 310020 quote holds price at 45.15 with 10-day terms
Scorecard red: OTD 63.5 %, 2376 ppm, score 69.9, class C
Formal escalation demanding an improvement plan for part:310020 and cost recovery
Contract: OTD target 95 %, EUR 150 per complaint, prices fixed per calendar year, 90-day notice, auto-extension after 2027-06-30
Historically settles about 2.2 pts below its ask; past increase requests settled at 0 %
310030 price 30.14 vs no-margin estimate 35.98 (low confidence, other plant)

indicators.credit_index: 225 (12 months ago 225; higher is worse, >300 weak)
